$comment: Pinned third-party dependencies. Velopack is the only third-party runtime
dependency this project has, deliberately. Each entry carries a sha256 that
Restore-Dependencies.ps1 verifies; a version string alone would let a
re-tagged release change the bytes under us without notice.
nlohmann/json is NOT ported from the old build: it existed only to
serialise IPC JSON, and the named-pipe protocol here is fixed-layout.
core/json (issue #6) is written from scratch instead.

velopack.$staticAlternative: lib-static/velopack_libc_win_x64_msvc.lib exists in the same archive (9 MB). Linking it would remove the sidecar DLL from the install, at an unmeasured cost in EXE size and cold-start paging. Decide in Phase 6 (issue #28) with a measurement, not now.
